commit.message:
Fix PWA offline correctness in workbox config

Three offline-from-homescreen failure modes caught by the new
@freegamestore/compliance PWA-offline check:

- Raise maximumFileSizeToCacheInBytes to 10 MB so the main bundle
  is precached (default 2 MB silently drops bigger chunks).
- Add runtimeCaching for fonts.googleapis.com / fonts.gstatic.com
  so Google Fonts work on cold offline launch in iOS standalone.
- Extend globPatterns to wasm + json so non-default asset types
  (e.g. stockfish.wasm) get precached.

Mirrors the reference config in the bowling repo.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Bump @freegamestore/games to ^0.13.0

docs(CLAUDE): adopt slim per-repo shape

Refactors this CLAUDE.md to the slim convention documented in
SKILLS.md. Platform-wide knowledge (tech stack, brand, deploy,
mobile rules, paths) lives in SKILLS.md as the single source of
truth -- duplicating it per repo just creates drift surface area
that breaks AI agents over time. This file now only carries
what is unique to this repo.

fix(pwa): NetworkFirst on HTML so fresh deploys are picked up immediately

Service worker was serving cached index.html with stale asset references
after a deploy. Vite content-hashes assets correctly, but the cached HTML
pointed at old hashes, so users saw the old version until all tabs closed.

NetworkFirst on navigation requests means: when online, always fetch fresh
HTML (3s timeout, fall back to cache). When offline, precached index.html
still serves via navigateFallback. Best of both worlds.

Also reformatted vite.config.ts from one 1KB line into readable structure.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

refactor(PlayTab): split into 6 focused sub-components

Extract from PlayTab:
- EvalBar — Stockfish eval visualization
- PlayerRow — opponent / player avatar+label row (reused twice)
- GameControls — New/Undo/Flip/Mic button row
- DifficultyColorPicker — difficulty 1-5 + color w/b pills
- GameOverBanner — terminal-state message + Play Again
- VoiceInstructions — voice command cheatsheet

PlayTab function: 508 → 393 lines, complexity 75 → 66
VCQA: B 81 → B 82 (confusion C 65 → A 90)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

chore: code-health pass — Cburnett pieces, VCQA fixes, build unbroken

- Replace Unicode piece glyphs with Cburnett SVG set (CC-BY-SA, lichess/Wikipedia)
- Add README, CHANGELOG, SECURITY, CONTRIBUTING (docs F 10 → covered)
- Tighten compliance.yml permissions (default-deny + workflow scope read)
- Add repository/license/homepage to package.json
- Add Content-Security-Policy meta (self + Google Fonts + wasm worker)
- Patch moderate vulns via pnpm overrides (brace-expansion, ws)
- Rename generic vars: update → updateSettings, result → evalResult/sentence, input → spoken
- Collapse duplicate highlight rects in Board.tsx into one conditional rect
- Extract undoMovePair helper in PlayTab.tsx (was duplicated across voice + button)
- Exclude src/test from tsconfig.app.json so prod build doesn't trip on node: imports
- Ignore .vibe-check/ generated reports

VCQA: B 75 → B 81 (+6 pts, 23 issues fixed)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add Kenney pixel-art graphics and fix StrictMode WebGL crash

- 9 CC0 sprites under web/public/sprites/ from Kenney "Pixel Platformer"
  and "Background Elements" packs (~17 KB total, served as static assets;
  zero JS bundle impact). LICENSE.txt records attribution.
- Sprite-based player (2-frame hop animation), tiled grass-top platforms,
  spinning coin sprites
- 3-layer parallax background: distant mountains, mid + near hills,
  drifting clouds, sun with halo, sky gradient
- Defer kaplay() into a queueMicrotask so React 19 StrictMode's
  synchronous setup -> cleanup -> setup sequence doesn't quit-then-recreate
  on the same canvas (which lost the WebGL context and left the game
  loop ticking on a dead context)
- compliance test: drop unused const that was blocking tsc -b
- pnpm-lock: align with package.json's ^0.13.0 SDK pin

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

ci: add Cloudflare Pages deploy workflow

The repo had no .github/workflows/ at all — every push to main since
the PWA migration has been a no-op. The site at bowling.freegamestore.online
is still serving the pre-vite-plugin-pwa build (manifest.json, separate
babylon chunk, no service worker), which is why recent fixes weren't
visible.

Mirrors the deploy.yml used across sibling games (2048, chess, pacman,
etc): build with pnpm, then `wrangler pages deploy web/dist` against
the freebowlingapp project. CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN secret expected at
the org level.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: harden localStorage, point arrow head along lane

- App.tsx: getBestScore wraps localStorage read in try/catch, validates
  parsed int is finite and non-negative. trySetBestScore swallows
  setItem failures. Safari Private was previously a crash path: setItem
  throws QuotaExceededError, which would propagate out of the game-over
  handler. Bad data (e.g. NaN) was also a soft-lock — high score could
  never update once corrupted.
- Game.tsx: arrow head triangle now actually points toward the pins.
  The Y-aligned 3-tessellation cylinder had its apex on +X; rotating .y
  by π just moved it to -X, perpendicular to the arrow shaft. Lay it on
  its side via rotation.x = -π/2 so the +Y apex becomes -Z (down the
  lane), and bump height so the apex extends past the arrow body tip.
- Game.tsx: canvas.parentElement!.appendChild → optional chaining.
  Defensive, no behavior change in normal mount path.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: patch dep vuln, add CSP, dedupe throw logic

- brace-expansion 5.0.0-5.0.5 (moderate, GHSA-jxxr-4gwj-5jf2) reached
  the build via workbox-build → glob → minimatch. Added a pnpm
  override pinning to >=5.0.6. `pnpm audit` is now clean.
- Content-Security-Policy meta tag on index.html. Locks scripts/
  workers/img/connect to self; allows the Google Fonts CSS/woff2 the
  PWA already loads.
- handleThrowComplete: extracted nextThrow(resetAll) helper. The 10th-
  frame branches no longer repeat `resetAllPins(); startAiming();` and
  `hideKnockedPins(); resetStandingPins(); startAiming();` three times.
- Renamed pin variable `body` → `pinBody` so it doesn't shadow the
  more obvious DOM meaning.
- .gitignore: add .vibe-check/ so the vcqa report artifacts don't get
  committed.

vcqa: B 75/100 → B 77/100, 6 issues fixed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix PWA offline correctness in workbox config

Three offline-from-homescreen failure modes caught by the new
@freegamestore/compliance PWA-offline check:

- Raise maximumFileSizeToCacheInBytes to 10 MB so the main bundle
  is precached (default 2 MB silently drops bigger chunks).
- Add runtimeCaching for fonts.googleapis.com / fonts.gstatic.com
  so Google Fonts work on cold offline launch in iOS standalone.
- Extend globPatterns to wasm + json so non-default asset types
  (e.g. stockfish.wasm) get precached.

Mirrors the reference config in the bowling repo.
